title: Wide Mouth Versatile Funnel, Canning Funnels for Kitchen Use, Food Grade Plastic Cooking Funnel Set with 4 Size Spouts and 2 Strainers for Filling Different Bottles and Bags, Blue
description:
About this item
5 Sizes Mouth: Wide opening funnel has 5 size spouts. 2'' spout for mason jars; 1.32'' spout for squeeze bottle and pouch; 0.93'' spout for spice jars; 0.67'' spout for oil and sugar bottles; 0.44'' spout for foaming dispensers bottles
High Quality Plastic: Made of heat-resistant food grade hard plastic that can withstand up to 332.60 ℉ (167 ℃). Perfect for transferring liquids like boiling water, hot soup, or coffee with ease
Detachable and Rotating Screw Design: Just rotating the spout you can get a different mouth funnel(1.1 cm, 1.7 cm, 2.36 cm, 3.35 cm, 5 cm), allowing you to fill any food, cosmetic or particles into different sizes bottles
Two Sizes Strainers: Come with two filters of different mesh sizes, allowing you to achieve perfect filtration every time. This large funnel with two filters will be the best helpers in your kitchen
Easy to Clean: Made of hard plastic material, it's dishwasher safe and easy to clean. They even come with a small brush to help you clean the spout with ease
Great Idea for Life Gift: Our versatile funnel set is the ultimate helper you've been looking for! Perfect as a gift for your wife, mom, family, and friends who share your passion for life

I dont often write reviews, I'm ashamed to say, because I use them when buying items. But this funnel set needs to be reviewed because they are fantastic!!! What a great idea to have a large capacity bowl in the funnel with a smaller opening for so many different containers. Great product!!! I have been telling all my friends about them. Thank you to the manufacturer and the creator for making these.This product was exactly what I wanted, it comes with many different sized funnel spouts, which all screw easily onto the wide canning funnel, and it has two different sized screens to catch things like large tea leaves, or fruit pulp.

It's sturdily made, easy to wash, and I'm very pleased with it. Being made of sturdy solid plastic, I don't have to worry about it flexing on me like my older funnel did.

I'm very pleased.This funnel set is very handy when transferring foods from a preparation vessel into a storage vessel. (IE. from a pot into a freezer bag.) The wide mouth helps to contain spillage and the several sized spouts permit filling a wide range of containers from mason jars to dispensing bottles.I don't know how I lived without these for so long. I bought it just for the wide funnel because I have the traditional funnels in the different sizes, but they are too narrow at the bottom for what I needed. Since buying this set, I no longer use the traditional funnels. I'm amazed at how much I love these! So well made, so functional, so convenient, and take up so little room!Wanted a funnel that had a larger opening than most kitchen funnels. This fit the bill. reviews_1s:
Update 01/27/2024: They sent me a replacement right away which also had no bag and in the meantime they removed the bag from the item photos. There was a photo there yesterday showing the bag. I also bought a pink one at the same time and it came with a bag. Not cool.

This came without the bag to store it in. I also ordered a pink one and it had a bag. If it matters to you, the blue color of the funnel is not the same as the color in the photo. It is more translucent, lighter blue and dull. The pink one, however, looked just like the photo. I will be returning this one for a replacement. Maybe I will get lucky and they will send one that is the actual color in this photo. I like the idea of it, I just hope the funnel attachments stay on. You'll want to make double sure the attachment has actually screwed in place correctly so it won't fall off while you are using it. Also, the strainer that fits in the inside falls out easily, but if you're careful it will probably stay in place. I won't be using it that much so it will work for me but I also will not be throwing away the funnel that I already had. It's much more durable and I don't have to work to get an attachment on it.The size-reducing attachments thread onto the large funnel, but as shown in the picture, do not seal against the opening. The attachments were tightened securely and were tested with water . They all leaked water through the threads which ran down the outside of the attachments.
